headings.description: Bold, industrial, and highly architectural. Used for all major headings and kinetic text.

body.description: Clean, highly legible geometric sans for paragraphs, UI elements, and navigation.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[7vw] leading-none tracking-tighter

background.description: Strictly adhered to white/off-white background as requested by user. Ensures a clinical, high-end architectural feel.

text.description: Deep obsidian and charcoal for maximum contrast against white.

accent.description: Deep brick-red from the logo. Used sparingly for buttons, key highlights, and active states.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. gap-8 to gap-16 for grids.
layouts.grid_strategy: Bento-style grids for Services (Mode A: The Tetris Grid). Asymmetrical layouts. High use of negative space to convey luxury and scale.
layouts.header: Fixed at top, z-50. bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5. Must contain Logo, Links, and AL/EN toggle. NO completely transparent background on header.

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis is MANDATORY. Standard browser scroll is forbidden.
motion.hero_intro: 3D Elevator Door Intro: Create an absolute positioned full-screen overlay consisting of two 'doors' (left and right panels). Use framer-motion useScroll to slide them open (translateX -100% and 100%) as the user scrolls, revealing the main website content underneath.
motion.kinetic_typography: Line-by-line reveal using framer-motion (staggerChildren). Text masked with overflow-hidden wrappers.
motion.hover_states: Buttons use deep red background filling on hover. Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-2) with a sharper shadow.
motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide up (y: 20 -> 0) on mount.

components.navigation: Sticky top bar. Logo on left (LIFT ExprEss with wrench). Right side: Desktop links + AL/EN toggle. Mobile hamburger menu.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none). bg-[#A5262B] text-white. Hover state: darker red. Must have data-testid.
components.marquee: Editorial ribbon. 'Mirëmbajtje, shitje dhe servisim te ashensorve' running slowly across the screen with huge typography (text-[8vw] text-transparent text-stroke-black/10 or similar outline effect).
components.services_showcase: Asymmetrical grid. Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03). Large titles, small descriptive text, leading to respective internal pages.

media.image_strategy: Images should have slight monochromatic or high-contrast filters to fit the white/black/red aesthetic. Use CSS grayscale(100%) on idle, revealing color on hover.

pages.home: Full screen elevator door intro on scroll. Once open, hero section with kinetic text. Services summary bento grid. Marquee text. Numbered manifesto. Contact teaser.
pages.services: Detailed breakdown of Maintenance, Sales, Service/Repair. Technical specs, imagery of technicians.
pages.about_contact: Company history. Map, Address (Rruga Ali Kelmendi, Prishtinë 10000), Phone (+383 43 901 313), Hours. Contact form.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance for #0A0A0A on #FFFFFF.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. If true, skip elevator intro and just fade in.

instructions_to_main_agent: You must build a 3-page site with react-router-dom: Home, Services, About+Contact.

Implement the signature full-screen Elevator intro on the Home page using Framer Motion. The screen is initially covered by two metallic/white door panels. On wheel scroll, they slide horizontally to reveal the hero section.
Add an AL/EN language toggle in the header. Mock the translation state.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for complex marketing layouts. Use Shadcn for basic UI like forms/inputs.
Follow the color palette strictly: #FFFFFF bg, #0A0A0A text, #A5262B accent.
Do NOT use Inter or Roboto. Include Google Fonts for 'Cabinet Grotesk' or 'Outfit', and 'Satoshi' or 'DM Sans'.
Ensure Lenis smooth scroll is implemented at the root level.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use stark contrasts and brutalist/editorial spacing.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. py-24 or py-32 for sections.
Never use placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided image_urls.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
